highlights.title: Faster algorithm with identical dosing
changes: The insulin-calculation pipeline runs about twice as fast in testing.
Dosing decisions are unchanged and match previous outputs exactly.
New automated parity tests record and compare exact outputs across many scenarios.
Calculation-heavy scenarios use less CPU time, improving responsiveness.

sources.title: nightscout/Trio#1377: Performance Optimization for Trio’s oref-swift Implementation

highlights.title: Fix repeated Omnipod reconnects
changes: Stops the self-inflicted connect → cancel → reconnect loop when using Omnipod connect-on-demand.
Trio now uses a newer OmnipodKit version that includes this connectivity fix.

includedPullRequests.body:
## oref-swift performance pass

Speeds up the native oref pipeline ~2× with **bit-identical dosing behavior**. Every change is either a pure refactor (same values, same rounding, same operation order) or verified byte-for-byte by golden tests recorded on unmodified code.

  ### What changed

  - **Golden parity harness** — 14 scenarios (low/high BG, active COB, temp target, override, dynamic ISF log/sigmoid, autosens both directions, suspend/resume, dense 24 h history, stale BG, DST/winter clock) with committed byte-exact goldens for every pipeline stage (profile, autosens, meal, IOB, determination incl. the full `reason` string). Re-record with `TEST_RUNNER_TRIO_RECORD_GOLDENS=1`.
  - **Cache ISF and basal schedules in hot loops** — the per-bucket rebuild+sort of the ISF/basal schedules (autosens simulation, COB detection, temp-basal splitting) is hoisted into prepared, sorted lookup tables built once per loop.
  - **Hoist invariant curve constants out of IOB loop** — the exponential-curve constants and duplicated `exp`/`pow` work move out of the per-treatment kernel; identical left-associated arithmetic, so results are bit-identical.
  - **Reuse prepared IOB inputs across time points** — treatments are preprocessed once (insulin pre-converted, nil-insulin events dropped) and each `iobTotal` call selects its window via binary search over the sorted array instead of a full-array filter.
  - **Share treatment computation across autosens runs** — the 8 h and 24 h autosens runs and the per-carb-entry COB loop no longer rebuild identical intermediate arrays.
  - **Compute wall-clock time without Calendar** — `Calendar.dateComponents` is replaced by a UTC-offset computation cached between DST transitions. This is the one deliberate exception to keeping the algorithm stateless (it is only a cache, marked as such in the code); a dedicated parity test sweeps DST transitions and sub-second boundaries against `Calendar`.

  ### Performance

Transcribed and de-identified. I've mapped the three testers to **A / B / C**, keeping the same letter for the before/after pair so the optimization comparison stays intact (A un-opt → A opt is the same setup; B and C are the other two datasets).

### A — un-optimized (24 h wear, n=629)

| --------------------------- | ---- | ------------- | ----------- | --------------- |
| cycle.total                 | 629  | 1345.2        | 123.3       | 5224.7          |
| cycle.fetchInputs           | 629  | 193.4         | 18.1        | 1472.5          |
| cycle.meal                  | 629  | 361.7         | 21.9        | 1545.6          |
| cycle.iob                   | 629  | 476.2         | 45.5        | 2075.0          |
| cycle.determineBasal        | 629  | 170.6         | 17.5        | 1256.7          |
| convertTempBasalToBolus     | 2612 | 103.4         | 7.8         | 485.3           |
| iob.totalLoop               | 629  | 107.4         | 10.7        | 800.4           |
| meal.carbEntriesLoop        | 629  | 181.1         | 0.0         | 1295.5          |
| meal.finalCobDetect         | 629  | 165.2         | 13.8        | 610.5           |
| determineBasal.forecasts    | 629  | 126.5         | 12.9        | 930.9           |
| autosensCycle.total         | 89   | 1250.9        | 137.8       | 3384.7          |
| autosens.generate.8h / 24h  | 89   | 580.0 / 567.0 | 62.7 / 58.5 | 1693.8 / 1487.8 |

### B — un-optimized (24 h wear, n=489)

| stage                       | n    | median        | min         | max            |
| --------------------------- | ---- | ------------- | ----------- | -------------- |
| cycle.total                 | 489  | 678.2         | 84.0        | 9796.3         |
| cycle.fetchInputs           | 489  | 101.3         | 12.6        | 3588.0         |

### A — optimized (24 h wear, n=282), Δ median vs A un-optimized

| stage                       | n   | median        | min         | max           | Δ median                              |
| --------------------------- | --- | ------------- | ----------- | ------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| cycle.total                 | 282 | 868.9         | 81.2        | 4736.3        | **−35%**                              |
| cycle.fetchInputs           | 282 | 170.4         | 17.9        | 2473.2        | −12% (untouched)                      |
| cycle.meal                  | 282 | 220.3         | 18.9        | 1498.9        | −39%                                  |
| cycle.iob                   | 282 | 171.0         | 18.0        | 717.3         | **−64%**                              |
| cycle.determineBasal        | 282 | 163.2         | 0.9         | 776.3         | −4% (untouched)                       |
| convertTempBasalToBolus     | 482 | 79.4          | 7.5         | 469.3         | −23%, and **1.7 calls/cycle vs 4.2**  |
| iob.totalLoop               | 282 | 17.1          | 1.8         | 73.9          | **−84%**                              |
| meal.carbEntriesLoop        | 282 | 0.1           | 0.0         | 1179.8        | see note                              |
| meal.finalCobDetect         | 282 | 139.7         | 13.7        | 658.2         | −15%                                  |
| determineBasal.forecasts    | 277 | 120.8         | 12.3        | 596.0         | −5% (untouched)                       |
| autosensCycle.total         | 39  | 542.6         | 59.1        | 1031.9        | **−57%**                              |
| autosens.generate.8h / 24h  | 39  | 155.2 / 146.9 | 17.0 / 16.2 | 292.8 / 312.6 | **−73%**                              |

| -------------------------------- | --- | ------- | --- | ---- |
| A un-opt (24 h wear)             | 629 | 1345    | 123 | 5225 |
| B un-opt (24 h wear)             | 489 | 678     | 84  | 9796 |
| A opt (24 h wear)                | 282 | 869     | 81  | 4736 |
| C un-opt (45 min, high-QoS)      | 10  | **101** | 85  | 117  |

| stage                | A un-opt  | B un-opt  | A opt     | C               |
| -------------------- | --------- | --------- | --------- | --------------- |
| cycle.iob            | 476       | 199       | 171       | 36              |

| cycle.determineBasal | 171       | 96        | 163       | 14              |
| autosens 8h / 24h    | 580 / 567 | 201 / 207 | 155 / 147 | 56 / 55 (n=1)   |

  Backtested against `dev` on 239,064 real-world input records across 13 timezones:
  every compared determination is identical.

includedPullRequests.title: Bump OmnipodKit to e31a8d1
includedPullRequests.body:
Moves the `OmnipodKit` submodule to the current tip of [loopandlearn/OmnipodKit `dev`](https://github.com/loopandlearn/OmnipodKit/tree/dev).

`cc47471` → `e31a8d1`

### What's included

Two commits, [loopandlearn/OmnipodKit#124](https://github.com/loopandlearn/OmnipodKit/pull/124):

- `82ac60b` Fix self-inflicted connect → cancel → reconnect loop in connect-on-demand
- `e31a8d1` Merge pull request #124 from loopandlearn/fix/backport-connectondemand-self-disconnect-loop
